blocks.task_summary: Show that the position vector of the intersection of L1 and L2 is (1, 8, -2).
method_path: Set up equations by equating components of L1 and L2.
Solve for parameters s and t.
Substitute parameter into line equation to find intersection point.
Verify the position vector is (1, 8, -2).

evidence.basis: M1: attempt to set up a system of equations with at least one correct equation; A1: t=1 OR s=-4; A1: point of intersection (1,8,-2) AG.

blocks.task_summary: Write vector equation of plane Π containing L1 and L2, and show Cartesian equation is 4x+y-3z=18.
method_path: Write plane equation in form r = a + λb + μc using point on L1 or L2 and direction vectors of L1 and L2.
Find normal vector n = b × c = (4,1,-3).
Use r·n = a·n to get Cartesian equation 4x+y-3z=18.
accepted_alternatives: Use any point on L1 or L2 for a.
Use r·n = a·n with any point from L1 or L2.

evidence.basis: b(i) A1: r = (5,4,2)+λ(1,-1,1)+μ(2,1,3) or equivalent; b(ii) M1: attempt to write equation in form r·n = a·n; A1: 4x+y-3z=18 AG.

blocks.task_summary: Write down the values of q and r where plane intersects axes at Q(0,q,0) and R(0,0,r).
method_path: Substitute y=0, z=0 into 4x+y-3z=18 to find x-intercept (given).
Substitute x=0, z=0 to find q=18.
Substitute x=0, y=0 to find r=-6.

blocks.task_summary: Use a vector method to find the area of triangle PQR.
method_path: Find vectors PQ and PR.
Compute cross product PQ × PR.
Find magnitude of cross product.
Area = 1/2 |PQ × PR|.

evidence.basis: A1: PQ or PR seen; M1: attempt to find vector product; A1: PQ×PR = (-108, -27, 81); M1: attempt magnitude; A1: Area = 1/2 √18954 ≈ 68.8.

blocks.task_summary: Write equation of line L3 normal to Π through intersection point.
method_path: Use intersection point (1,8,-2) as position vector.
Use normal vector (4,1,-3) as direction vector.

evidence.basis: A2: r = (1,8,-2) + γ(4,1,-3); Note: Accept any multiple of direction vector. Award A1A0 if r= is not seen.

blocks.task_summary: Given S(-11,5,7) lies on L3, find γ.
method_path: Solve component equations for γ.
Obtain γ = 3.

evidence.basis: M1: attempt to set r3 equal to (-11,5,7); A1: γ=3.

blocks.task_summary: Find the volume of pyramid PQRS.
method_path: Find vector from S to intersection point (height direction).
Compute height = magnitude of this vector.
Use volume = 1/3 × base area × height.
Base area from part (d).

evidence.basis: M1: attempt to subtract appropriate vectors; A1: height = √234; M1: attempt to substitute into volume formula; A1: V=351.
